verdict.rationale: Zoho CRM documents its own programmatic, UI-free surface: REST CRUD and COQL APIs, official Python and Node.js SDKs, async bulk write of up to 25,000 records with callback or status polling, scoped access, and credit headers for rate-limit handling. A CLI is mentioned, but only for building Zia agents, and nothing documents running CRM automation in CI pipelines or non-interactive credentials suited to CI. missing for 10: official CLI for CRM operations, documented CI/pipeline usage or examples, explicit non-interactive service-account auth guidance, independent hands-on corroboration.
